fields.description: Issue includes an editorial on a Dade County grand jury investigation into gambling and allegations of politically motivated indictments, discussing State's Attorney Vernon Hawthorne, County Attorney Fred Pine, and State Senator Hayes Lewis, with references to Miami Beach politics and the Daily News. Also includes local columns and notices about nightlife and entertainment, racing coverage and tips related to Hialeah Park, commentary on the Biscayne Kennel Club greyhound meet, and a feature on a walkathon contest on Ocean Drive in Miami Beach, alongside numerous advertisements for clubs, bars, and local businesses.
